pages.title: Next-Generation Tunnel Slime
pages.text: A compact royal tunneler created by $(l:world/royal_synthesis)Royal Synthesis$() from an ordinary and Ancient Tunnel Slime. It starts in Wait. Its small cart, goggles, and caliper crest distinguish it. Verified parental growth returns as unused points.

Open Bore size in the Slime Tuner. Enter a positive side length n, then Apply: 1 makes 1×1, 2 makes 2×2, and 5 makes 5×5. The default is 3×3. Changing size or direction selects Wait. Issue Tunnel separately. The bore and lining must fit within world height.

From the entrance it works across one n×n face with expanded work reach, one block at a time. It completes the face and repairs its floor, roof, and sides before moving forward. The lining template is not consumed; real blocks come from its bag. Unloaded terrain pauses work.

It retains half stamina costs and 50% faster ancient masonry work. Tools, required tiers, buckets, cargo space, and protection events still apply. $(l:companions/transport)Transport$() and Warehouse Slimes supply tools and lining; Signaling Slimes report stops. Recovery preserves size and progress and deploys in Wait.
